reviewedBy: lane B, 26 Sep 2026: CCC event permit application form, waste management section

items.text: Confirms the organiser will remove and dispose of all waste from the event location
items.sourceQuote: You are responsible for the appropriate removal and disposal of all waste from the event location.

items.text: Explains how waste will be managed at the event
items.sourceQuote: Please provide detail on how waste will be managed at the event (or attach document below):

items.text: For events of about 1000 attendees or more: estimates the types and amounts of waste
items.sourceQuote: Provide an estimate of the types and amounts of waste likely to be generated at your event.

items.text: For events of about 1000 attendees or more: lists actions to minimise waste
items.sourceQuote: What actions are you taking to minimise the waste generated at your event?

items.text: For events of about 1000 attendees or more: gives a landfill diversion estimate or target percentage
items.sourceQuote: Provide an estimate or target percentage of the amount of waste you anticipate diverting from landfill.

items.text: For events of about 1000 attendees or more: lists equipment to collect and transport waste and diverted materials
items.sourceQuote: What equipment is being provided to collect and transport the waste and diverted materials?

items.text: For events of about 1000 attendees or more: names who collects and disposes of the waste
items.sourceQuote: Who (individual or organisation) is responsible for collection and disposal of the waste?

items.text: For events of about 1000 attendees or more: says when and how often waste is collected
items.sourceQuote: When and how often during your event will your waste be collected and disposed?

items.text: For events of about 1000 attendees or more: explains how litter and spillages are managed
items.sourceQuote: Outline how you intend to manage litter and spillages during or associated with your event?
